name: Inventory risk
prompt: Inventory risk: items below reorder point by category, days of cover for the riskiest SKUs, and warehouse utilization

binding.sql:
SELECT
  category AS category,
  COUNT(*) AS below_reorder_count
FROM stock_risk
WHERE below_reorder = TRUE
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY below_reorder_count DESC, category
LIMIT {{params.top_n}}

copy.title: Reorder risk by category
copy.caption: Electronics has the most items below reorder point; Chemicals has the fewest.

binding.sql:
WITH sku_risk AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    product,
    MIN(days_of_cover) AS min_days_of_cover
  FROM stock_risk
  WHERE below_reorder = TRUE
    AND days_of_cover IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sku, product
)
SELECT
  sku || ' — ' || product AS sku_name,
  ROUND(min_days_of_cover, 1) AS days_of_cover
FROM sku_risk
ORDER BY days_of_cover ASC, sku_name ASC
LIMIT {{params.top_n}}

copy.title: Lowest stock cover SKUs
copy.caption: Wiring Harness 2m is most at risk with 0.7 days of cover; the next items are under 2 days.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  warehouse AS warehouse,
  utilization_pct AS utilization_pct
FROM warehouse_utilization
ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC, warehouse

copy.title: Warehouse utilization
copy.caption: GDL-1 has the highest storage pressure at 34.9%, more than 10 points above the next site.

binding.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    sku AS sku,
    product AS product,
    category AS category,
    warehouse AS warehouse,
    on_hand AS on_hand,
    reorder_point AS reorder_point,
    days_of_cover AS days_of_cover,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN days_of_cover IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        days_of_cover ASC,
        (reorder_point - on_hand) DESC,
        sku ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM stock_risk
  WHERE below_reorder = TRUE
)
SELECT
  sku,
  product,
  category,
  warehouse,
  on_hand,
  reorder_point,
  days_of_cover
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= LEAST(CAST({{params.top_n}} AS INTEGER), 50)
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN days_of_cover IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  days_of_cover ASC,
  (reorder_point - on_hand) DESC,
  sku ASC

copy.title: Critical stock risks
copy.caption: All listed SKUs are below reorder, with RTM-1 and packaging items at the thinnest cover.
